decision.explanation: Mario Magnozzi is stated to have represented AC Milan (D1S7) and later joined FC Nara-ShBFR Naro-Fominsk (D2S3). These are two distinct teams directly mentioned in the sources as representing him. 'Inter Milan' (C2) is referenced in D1S14 as a rival team, not as one he represents. 'Empoli' (C3) is his hometown club (D1S6), but there is no explicit statement that he represented them in a professional capacity. Therefore, only AC Milan and FC Nara-ShBFR Naro-Fominsk are valid answers.
